xquery version "1.0-ml";
let $films := cts:search(fn:collection("ochre/concept")/ochre/concept, cts:and-query((cts:element-attribute-value-query(xs:QName("ochre"), xs:QName("uuidBelongsTo"), "30a6cec8-849f-4c03-be3a-469cdb749398"), cts:element-attribute-value-query(xs:QName("tree"), xs:QName("uuid"), "5f69ef7c-9006-4e7a-bf56-0f266346f9fb"))), ("unfiltered", cts:index-order(cts:element-attribute-reference(xs:QName("interpretation"), xs:QName("date")), "descending")))[parent::ochre/@uuidBelongsTo = "30a6cec8-849f-4c03-be3a-469cdb749398"][context/context/tree/@uuid = "5f69ef7c-9006-4e7a-bf56-0f266346f9fb"][interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property]
let $matching := for $film in $films let $year := normalize-space(string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "ceaecbc7-d1bc-4a6a-8698-7193f07c4f2a"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")) where (if ($year castable as xs:integer) then (xs:integer($year) ge 1970 and xs:integer($year) lt 1980) else false()) and lower-case(normalize-space(string-join($film/identification/label/content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, " "))) = ("the godfather", "star wars", "alien", "the godfather part ii", "a clockwork orange", "taxi driver", "jaws", "one flew over the cuckoo's nest", "apocalypse now", "rocky", "the exorcist", "grease", "monty python and the holy grail", "halloween", "the aristocats", "life of brian", "rocky ii", "close encounters of the third kind", "robin hood", "carrie") return $film
let $rows := for $film in subsequence($matching, 1, 50) return <film uuid="{$film/@uuid}"><title>{string-join($film/identification/label/content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, " ")}</title><year>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "ceaecbc7-d1bc-4a6a-8698-7193f07c4f2a"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</year><director>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "6ce91c0c-34c5-46e4-9e22-434269f089d4"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</director><country>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "900560b7-7279-4f4d-bf0f-3393a346ed76"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</country></film>
return <ochre><rows totalCount="{count($matching)}">{$rows}</rows></ochre>
